title: Glazier Mobile App | Glass Job Management on Your Phone | Coglass
description: The Coglass mobile app puts your jobs, surveys, schedules and delivery records on your phone. Works offline. iOS and Android. Built for glaziers on site.
lead: Office staff run the web app; fitters run the iOS and Android apps — survey, fit, clock in, capture photos and signatures on site. Offline-first, so it keeps working when the signal doesn't.
steps_h2: Your team's full working day — in one app
steps_sub: From arriving on site to collecting the customer's signature, the Coglass app handles every step.
inc_h2: Built for glaziers who work on site every day
inc_sub: Not a watered-down version of the desktop — a fully featured field app designed for how glaziers actually work.
steps: Field staff open the app and see their assigned jobs for the day — customer name, address, visit type (survey, fitting, delivery) and time slot. All assigned by the office via the planning board.

Tap any job to see the full order: customer contact, site address, access notes, special instructions, previous survey photos and glass specifications. Everything they need before ringing the doorbell.

Start a survey visit, measure each pane, add drawings and photos. All measurements are captured in millimetres with location labels, shape, operations and notes — synced to the office when back in signal.
On a fitting visit, work through the completion checklist. Mark items as fitted, record snag notes and photos, capture GPS proof of location, and note any access issues or follow-up work needed.
Once work is complete, the customer signs directly on the screen. The signed record is stored against the job — time-stamped, GPS-tagged and available in the office immediately.
No signal on site? The app keeps working. All data is captured and queued locally. The moment signal returns, everything syncs automatically — photos, measurements, signatures, all of it.
included: Daily jobs list
See all jobs assigned for today with customer, address, visit type and time — assigned by the office from the planning board.
Full job details on site
Customer contact, access notes, special instructions, glass specs, previous surveys and photos — all visible before arriving on site.
Survey and measurement capture
Measure each pane, record shape, operations (Georgian bars, cutouts, lead) and photos — all synced to the order.
Fitting completion record
Checklist-based fitting record with snag notes, photos and partial fitting tracking with reasons.
Customer digital signature
Customers sign on screen at completion. Signature stored time-stamped and GPS-tagged against the job.
GPS proof of location
Location is recorded with arrival, departure and sign-off — proof the team was on site.
Offline mode
Keeps working without signal. Changes are queued on the phone and sync when the connection returns.
Push notifications
Staff get a push notification when today's bookings change, when they are tagged in a job update, and for office alerts.
Shop-floor iPad app
Workshop staff run the shop-floor app on an iPad — cut lists by station, barcode scan to advance, and collection sign-off.
Photo capture
Take photos on site and attach to measurements, surveys or job notes. Photos upload automatically when back in signal.
Planner view
See your schedule for the coming days — upcoming jobs, visit types and time slots all visible in the planner tab.
iOS and Android
Available on both platforms. Field teams can use their own devices — no specific hardware required.
cta_h2: Put your whole team on the same page
cta_p: Book a demo and we'll walk you through it on the kind of jobs you do — or pick a plan and start a 14-day trial.
